auditor_value: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason is the correct explanation of the Assertion (option (a) under the standard assertion-reason numbering).
question_defect: The served question has an empty options list; an assertion-reason item normally carries the four standard options. The solution assumes the standard numbering (1 = both true and R explains A; 2 = both true, R does not explain A; 3 = A true, R false) and, helpfully, writes the meaning of option 1 out in full, so a reader without the options can still use it.
notes: auditor_option = 1 is under the standard assertion-reason convention, since no options were served.
